checks: Execution gate off performs no Google requests or discovery writes
Discovery repairs missing post-booking enqueue and writes one deterministic event
Repeated discovery and enqueue do not duplicate confirmed delivery
Reschedule uses PATCH with exact ETag and preserves saved booking
Lost insert response reconciles the same ID without a second insert
409 insert conflict reads and reconciles owned exact-ID event
Foreign event ownership collision never overwrites another event
Cancellation deletes only the matching event and retains local booking and receipt

Completed visits preserve calendar history rather than deleting events
Paused customer saves changes without external writes and resumes latest lifecycle
Disconnect stops remote work and same-target reconnect resumes retained jobs
Different-account reconnect retains old event and blocks automatic migration
Revoked Google refresh grant pauses delivery without deleting local record
Delayed stale worker cannot overwrite a newer reschedule or receipt
Concurrent workers claim a job once
Delivery DTO excludes refresh tokens, target IDs, claim tokens and private metadata
Foreign tenant and legacy version fail closed
